llm_interactions: Zero reply rate × near-zero active days: seller is not just ignoring leads but is effectively absent from the platform entirely

TYPE_A sudden cliff × zero hotlead activity: abrupt drop with no high-intent engagement suggests a deliberate or crisis-driven withdrawal, not seasonal noise

script_parts.opening: Namaskar, Cuddles India se baat ho rahi hai? Ji, main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon — dekh raha tha ki aapka account kaafi purana hai, lagbhag 26 saal se aap hamare saath hain, lekin pichle 30 dinon mein sirf 1 active day record hua hai aur 3 buyer inquiries ka koi reply nahi gaya — toh seedha aapse baat karna zaroori laga.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai ji, pehle yeh samajhna chahta hoon — kya koi specific wajah hai jiske chalte platform pe login ya replies thodi kam ho gayi hain, jaise team change hua, ya koi aur channel pe focus shift hua, ya platform se koi issue tha?
script_parts.value_demo: Ek important baat share karta hoon — aapka CQS score abhi 22 hai, jo critical zone mein hai; iska matlab buyers jab search karte hain toh aapka listing unhe practically dikhta hi nahi. Upar se BL velocity is mahine -100% ho gayi hai, yani jo inquiries pehle aa rahi thi woh bilkul band ho gayi hain — yeh sudden cliff hai, ek-do mahine pehle activity thi, toh yeh recoverable hai agar abhi kaam karein.
script_parts.action: Toh bhai ji, abhi call pe hi ek kaam karte hain — aap apna IndiaMART account ek baar open karein, main aapko step-by-step CQS improve karne ke liye 2-3 catalog fields update karwata hoon aur un 3 unanswered BLs ka ek quick reply template set karte hain, 5 minute ka kaam hai.
script_parts.close: Bas itna commitment chahiye — aaj call ke baad ek baar login karein aur woh 3 buyers ko reply karein; main 3 din baad ek short follow-up call karoonga sirf yeh check karne ke liye ki koi aur help chahiye ya nahi, koi pressure nahi.

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, am I speaking with someone from Cuddles India? This is calling from IndiaMART — I noticed your account is nearly 26 years old with us, but in the last 30 days there has been only 1 active day recorded and 3 buyer inquiries have gone completely unanswered, so I felt it was important to reach out directly.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: Before anything else, I'd like to understand — is there a specific reason why logins and replies have slowed down recently, for example a team change, a shift in focus to another channel, or perhaps some issue with the platform itself?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's a critical data point: your CQS score is currently 22, which is in the critical zone, meaning buyers searching on the platform are essentially not finding your listing at all. On top of that, your BL velocity has dropped -100% month-on-month — but the good news is this is a sudden cliff, not a long-term pattern, so there is a real recovery window right now if we act quickly.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one concrete thing together right now on this call — please open your IndiaMART account and I will walk you through updating 2-3 catalog fields to improve your CQS score, and we'll also set up a quick reply template for those 3 unanswered buyer leads — this will take about 5 minutes.
script_parts_en.close: All I'm asking for is one small commitment — after this call, reply to those 3 buyers using the template we set up, and I'll do a short follow-up call in 3 days just to check if you need any further help, no pressure beyond that.

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
